text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen for five periods, so I should review my risk and whether my holdings fit my ten-year apartment goal rather than assume doing nothing is always right.","These losses alone do not tell me which stocks caused them or what prices will do next; I should avoid impulsive trades based on recent declines.","Before making a trade, I should check my cash, share holdings and current prices, and make sure any buy or sell is affordable and consistent with my plan."]}
